summary: Iteration 2 full backend + frontend testing for ABN Andhra News. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed (auth, categories CRUD incl. duplicate/delete-with-articles error paths, news list/flash/search/pagination/category filters, admin news CRUD with flash+gallery, livetv GET/PUT youtube+mp4). Frontend: All Telugu labels verified in nav, admin dashboard, article form, category form, livetv form, footer. Search (Prabhas→1 result), Category page, Article page (share Twitter/Facebook/WhatsApp + copy link), Admin login, 3 admin tabs (వార్తలు/విభాగాలు/లైవ్ టీవీ సెట్టింగ్‌లు), article table with ⚡ FLASH badges (5 flash items visible), full article-create modal with rich-text editor (Bold/Italic/Heading/Quote/List/Link/Undo/Redo toolbar buttons all present), flash toggle, gallery upload button, submit → new article appears in admin list AND flash marquee. Category add ('వాతావరణం') → appears in public nav; delete no-article category succeeds; delete sports (has articles) blocked with 400 error. LiveTV url change to a different youtube embed reflected on homepage iframe; mp4 stream_type renders <video> element on homepage. End-to-end integration verified.

issues: On slow renders, h1 briefly shows raw slug ('sports') before cats API resolves and Telugu name (క్రీడలు) replaces it — cats and news are fetched in Promise.all but setData/setCats are separate React state updates, causing one intermediate render with cats=[]. Non-blocking cosmetic race. Suggest showing skeleton until both are ready or use a single setState.

critical_code_review_comments: Category.jsx: replace two-setState with a single batched setter (or React 18 automatic batching should apply — verify) to avoid intermediate render showing slug instead of Telugu name.

Console warning: React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' spotted on public pages — likely from the AdminDashboard <select> option children (<option>{c.name_te} ({c.name_en})</option>) or a similar spot. Text-only children should be fine; check if any component is inserting a span inside <option>. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.
server.py DELETE /admin/settings/livetv is missing — only PUT exists. Not required by spec but consider adding a reset endpoint.
AdminDashboard.jsx is 543 lines with 3 subcomponents inline. Consider splitting CategoriesTab and LiveTVTab into separate files under /components/admin/. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test articles/categories created were cleaned up. LiveTV settings were briefly changed to test URLs then restored to default YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/embed/jfKfPfyJRdk, stream_type=youtube).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 21 backend pytest cases passing. Frontend flows all verified. Only cosmetic race-condition on Category page h1 initial render (shows slug until cats load). Rich text editor uses contenteditable — for automation set innerHTML via page.evaluate on '[data-testid="form-body-editor-area"]' and dispatch InputEvent. Gallery multi-upload requires real files; couldn't be automated via URL — backend gallery via images[] array works. Admin form testid button for login is 'admin-login-submit' (not 'admin-login-btn').
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Minor: Category.jsx h1 race on initial render — root cause: two consecutive setState calls (setData then setCats). React 18 auto-batches these so it should be a single render, but the observation indicates the render happened before setCats completed. Mitigation: combine into one setState({data, cats}) or gate h1 render on cats.length > 0.
